body: Final source review caught the fused histogram loop still using i+2*n/i+3*n despite declaring R_xlen_t stride. Corrected to stride in src/statistics.cpp and frozen source. This affects only very large matrix offset safety, not ordinary outputs; rerunning full check/coverage before checkpoint. Your graph snapshot may contain the preceding source, so do not silently claim that snapshot includes this final one-line fix. No other package changes planned.
